title: Big Pickle on SWE Atlas – Codebase QnA
summary: Big Pickle on SWE Atlas is a codebase question-answering tool that enables developers to query code repositories using natural language, leveraging large language models for code understanding and retrieval.
problem_solved: Helps developers quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases by answering questions in natural language.
why_valuable: Reduces time spent on code comprehension and onboarding by providing instant, AI-powered answers about codebase structure and functionality.
